cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc get configmap config -n openshift-kube-apiserver -o jsonpath='{.data.config\.yaml}' | jq -c '.apiServerArguments["event-ttl"]'
oc project -q > ns.txt && oc create serviceaccount eventrouter && oc create configmap eventrouter --from-file=config.json
oc apply -f eventrouter.yaml && oc rollout status deploy/eventrouter --timeout=180s

entries.cmd: oc logs deploy/eventrouter | grep -m 3 '"name":"broken' | jq -c '{verb, reason: .event.reason, object: .event.involvedObject.name, namespace: .event.involvedObject.namespace, message: (.event.message[0:70])}'
oc logs deploy/eventrouter | grep '^{' | jq -r '.event.involvedObject.namespace' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5
oc delete pod broken && oc get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=broken -o name | wc -l && oc logs deploy/eventrouter | grep -c '"name":"broken'
oc delete clusterrolebinding academy-event-reader && oc delete clusterrole academy-event-reader

snapshot.cmd: oc get clusterroles -o name | grep -c academy- || true
